Generate dot plot figure of nucmer alignments between chromosomes with the data points colored by percentage similarity,

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(dplyr)
library(magrittr)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(viridis)
library(stringr)
library(gridExtra)

# Import the reusable MUMmer functions from the separate R script.
source("/Users/waweru/Documents/2022/ThesisWriting/Chapter2/chr2DMummerData+Plots/mummerDotplotFunctions.R")

```

Reusable functions for reading and plotting MUMmer alignments are loaded from `mummer_dotplot_functions.R`.

Read Delta functions and plotting functions (adapted) used are from repository [here:](https://jmonlong.github.io/Hippocamplus/2017/09/19/mummerplots-with-ggplot2/)
Reads in delta file output from nucmer into R and summarises into dataframe

Adapting this section to alignments am working with, adding information for every ref-quary pair

```{r}

base_dir <- "/Users/waweru/Documents/2022/Python_learning/python_learning_with_Burkhard/chr2D_CS_635-650Mb/mummer_out/"

cut_off <- 99.99

chr <- "2D"
chrom <- paste0("chr", chr)

# Add one row for each reference-query comparison.
comparisons <- tibble::tribble(
  ~variety,       ~query,   ~delta_file,
  "chinesespring", "julius", "CS_2D_VS_julius_2D.delta",
  "chinesespring", "arina", "CS_2D_VS_arinaLrFor_2D.delta",
  "chinesespring", "jagger", "CS_2D_VS_jagger_2D.delta",
  "chinesespring", "lancer", "CS_2D_VS_lancer_2D.delta",
  "chinesespring", "landmark", "CS_2D_VS_landmark_2D.delta",
  "chinesespring", "mace", "CS_2D_VS_mace_2D.delta",
  "chinesespring", "norin61", "CS_2D_VS_norin61_2D.delta",
  "chinesespring", "stanley", "CS_2D_VS_stanley_2D.delta",
  "chinesespring", "symattis", "CS_2D_VS_symattis_2D.delta"
)

```

Plot the whole chromosome and telomeric region for each reference-query combination.

```{r}
library(scales) # to add commas to the axes labels
options(scipen = 999) # to remove exponential numbers in the axes
date <- Sys.Date() # add to the saved figures for posterity

for (i in seq_len(nrow(comparisons))) {
  variety <- comparisons$variety[i]
  query <- comparisons$query[i]
  ref <- variety

  data_dir_query <- paste0(base_dir, query, "/", comparisons$delta_file[i])
  plot_dir_WC <- paste0(base_dir, "2026-Aug/wholeChromPLots/")
  plot_dir_telo <- paste0(base_dir, "2026-Aug/teloIntvlPlots/")

  dir.create(plot_dir_WC,recursive = TRUE,showWarnings = FALSE)
  dir.create(plot_dir_telo,recursive = TRUE,showWarnings = FALSE)

  # Read alignments of at least 10 kb.
  #========================================================
  
  print(paste0("Reading delta file of ",ref," vs ",query))
  min_size <- 20000
  comparison_filt_20kb <- pre_plot_analysis(
    delta_path = data_dir_query,
    min_size = min_size
  )
  #========================================================
  #===== Plot the whole chromosome
  #========================================================
  
  print("Plotting whole chromosome dot plot")
  ref_start <- 0

  tiff(paste0(plot_dir_WC,date,"_dot_plot_",variety,"_2D_VS_",query,"_chromosome_","filt_",min_size,"bp.tiff"), res = 300, width = 9, height = 6, units = "in")
  filt_data <- comparison_filt_20kb %>% filter(rs >= ref_start) %>% filter(r_length >= min_size)
  print(
    filt_data %>% plot_by_perc_id_cap(., cap_lower = 97, cap_upper = 100) +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 5)) +
      theme(axis.text.y = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 5)) +
      scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(min(filt_data$qs),max(filt_data$qs) ,50000000), labels = scales::comma, name = paste0(query, " chr2D")) +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(filt_data$rs),max(filt_data$rs) ,50000000), labels = scales::comma, name = paste0(ref, " chr2D")) +
      ggtitle(label = paste0("Dot plot of ",ref," chr2D against chr2D of ",query), subtitle = paste0("Alignments longer than ", min_size, " bp")) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold.italic"))
  )
  dev.off()
  
  #========================================================================
  #========= Plot the telomeric region containing the interval of interest.
  #=========================================================================
  print("Plotting dot plot for the telomeric interval")
  
  ref_start <- 630000000
  ref_end <- 651852609 # last position on Chinese Spring chr2D

  ref_start_mb <- round(ref_start / 1e6)
  ref_end_mb <- round(ref_end / 1e6)

  tiff(paste0(plot_dir_telo,date,"_dot_plot_",variety,"_2D_VS_",query,"_",ref_start_mb,"-",ref_end_mb,"Mb_",min_size,"bp_telo.tiff"), res = 300, width = 9, height = 6, units = "in")
  filt_data <- comparison_filt_20kb %>% filter(rs >= ref_start) %>% filter(qs >= ref_start) %>% filter(r_length >= min_size)
  print(
    filt_data %>% plot_by_perc_id_cap(., cap_lower = 97, cap_upper = 100) +
      theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 7)) +
      theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7)) +
      scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(min(filt_data$qs),max(filt_data$qs) ,5000000), labels = scales::comma, name = paste0(query, " chr2D")) +
      scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(filt_data$rs),max(filt_data$rs) ,5000000), labels = scales::comma, name = paste0(ref, " chr2D")) +
      ggtitle(label = paste0("Dot plot of ",ref," chr2D against chr2D of ",query), subtitle = paste0("Alignments longer than ", min_size, " bp")) +
      theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold.italic"))
  )
  dev.off()


#========================================================
#===== annotated telomeric interval =====================
#===== alignments longer than 20 kb =====================

  print("Plotting annotated dot plot for the telomeric interval")
  
# This interval includes the Alcedo block, SNP marker and SSR marker.
  ref_start <- 633000000
  ref_end <- 645000000
  min_size <- 20000
  
  ref_start_mb <- round(ref_start / 1e6)
  ref_end_mb <- round(ref_end / 1e6)
  
  ref_label <- ifelse(
    tolower(ref) == "chinesespring",
    "Chinese Spring",
    stringr::str_to_title(ref)
  )
  query_label <- ifelse(
    tolower(query) == "chinesespring",
    "Chinese Spring",
    stringr::str_to_title(query)
  )
  
  # Positions of annotations on the Chinese Spring reference.
  annotation_data <- tibble::tribble(
    ~position,  ~annotation,
    634400000,  "Alcedo block boundaries",
    635000000,  "Alcedo block boundaries",
    635600441,  "AX-89766862 SNP marker",
    644277239,  "Xgwm320 SSR marker"
  )
  
  annotation_data$annotation <- factor(
    annotation_data$annotation,
    levels = c(
      "Alcedo block boundaries",
      "AX-89766862 SNP marker",
      "Xgwm320 SSR marker"
    )
  )
  
  annotation_colours <- c(
    "Alcedo block boundaries" = "#D55E00",
    "AX-89766862 SNP marker" = "#009E73",
    "Xgwm320 SSR marker" = "#0072B2"
  )
  
  annotation_linetypes <- c(
    "Alcedo block boundaries" = "solid",
    "AX-89766862 SNP marker" = "dashed",
    "Xgwm320 SSR marker" = "dotdash"
  )
  
  filt_data <- comparison_filt_20kb %>%
    filter(rs >= ref_start,re <= ref_end,r_length >= min_size )
  
  if (nrow(filt_data) == 0) {
    stop("No alignments passed the interval and minimum-length filters.")
  }
  
  query_start <- min(c(filt_data$qs, filt_data$qe), na.rm = TRUE)
  query_end <- max(c(filt_data$qs, filt_data$qe), na.rm = TRUE)
  
  tiff(
    paste0(
      plot_dir_telo, date, "_dot_plot_", variety, "_2D_VS_", query, "_",
      ref_start_mb, "-", ref_end_mb, "Mb_", min_size,
      "bp_telo_annotated.tiff"
    ),
    res = 300,
    width = 12,
    height = 6,
    units = "in"
  )
  
  annotated_plot <- filt_data %>%
    plot_by_perc_id_cap(
      xmin = ref_start - 1,
      xmax = ref_end + 1,
      cap_lower = 97,
      cap_upper = 100
    ) +
    geom_vline(
      data = filter(
        annotation_data,
        annotation == "Alcedo block boundaries"
      ),
      aes(xintercept = position, linetype = annotation),
      colour = annotation_colours[["Alcedo block boundaries"]],
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +
    geom_vline(
      data = filter(
        annotation_data,
        annotation == "AX-89766862 SNP marker"
      ),
      aes(xintercept = position, linetype = annotation),
      colour = annotation_colours[["AX-89766862 SNP marker"]],
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +
    geom_vline(
      data = filter(
        annotation_data,
        annotation == "Xgwm320 SSR marker"
      ),
      aes(xintercept = position, linetype = annotation),
      colour = annotation_colours[["Xgwm320 SSR marker"]],
      linewidth = 0.5
    ) +
    scale_linetype_manual(
      name = "Reference annotations",
      values = annotation_linetypes,
      guide = guide_legend(
        override.aes = list(
          colour = unname(annotation_colours),
          linewidth = 0.7
        )
      )
    ) +
    scale_x_continuous(
      limits = c(ref_start, ref_end),
      breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(n = 7),
      labels = scales::label_number(
        scale = 1e-6,
        accuracy = 0.1,
        suffix = " Mb"
      ),
      name = paste0(ref_label, " chr2D position")
    ) +
    scale_y_continuous(
      limits = c(query_start, query_end),
      breaks = scales::breaks_pretty(n = 7),
      labels = scales::label_number(
        scale = 1e-6,
        accuracy = 0.1,
        suffix = " Mb"
      ),
      name = paste0(query_label, " chr2D position")
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0(
        "Chromosome 2D alignment: ", ref_label,
        " (reference) vs ", query_label, " (query)"
      ),
      subtitle = paste0(
        ref_label, " interval ", ref_start_mb, "-", ref_end_mb,
        " Mb; alignments >= ", scales::comma(min_size), " bp"
      ),
      colour = "Alignment identity (%)",
      caption = "Vertical lines show block boundaries and marker positions on the reference."
    ) +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 7),
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold.italic"),
      plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 9),
      legend.position = "right",
      legend.box = "vertical"
    )
  
  print(annotated_plot)
  dev.off()
}
```


#### Looking at small specific regions, still with CS as the reference 

```{r}
# Use the Julius comparison for the single-run interval plots below.
variety <- "chinesespring"
query <- "julius"
ref <- variety

data_dir_query <- paste0(base_dir, query, "/", "CS_2D_VS_", query, "_2D.delta")
plot_dir <- paste0(base_dir, "2026-Aug/", query, "/")

comparison_filt_20kb <- pre_plot_analysis(
  delta_path = data_dir_query,
  min_size = 10000
)

comparison_filt_all <- pre_plot_analysis(
  delta_path = data_dir_query,
  min_size = 0
)

#========================================================
#===== plot for region with the SNP marker  ======
#===== alignments longer then 10kb, for a specific region ======

ref_start <- 633000000
ref_end <- 645000000
min_size <- 10000

## this values for file name
ref_start_mb <- round(ref_start / 1e6)
ref_end_mb   <- round(ref_end / 1e6)


tiff(paste0(plot_dir,date,"_dot_plot_",variety,"_2D_VS_",query,"_",ref_start_mb,"-",ref_end_mb,"_",min_size,"_telo_annotated.tiff"), res = 300, width = 9, height = 6, units = "in")
filt_data <- comparison_filt_20kb %>% filter(rs >= ref_start) %>% filter(re <= ref_end) %>% filter(r_length >= min_size)
 filt_data %>% plot_by_perc_id_cap(., cap_lower = 97, cap_upper = 100) + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7 )) +
   theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(min(filt_data$qs),max(filt_data$qs) ,500000), labels = scales::comma, name = paste0(query, " chr2D")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(filt_data$rs),max(filt_data$rs) ,250000), labels = scales::comma, name = paste0(ref, " chr2D")) +
   #add a vline to the position of the SNP (green),SSR (blue) and Alcedo block on CS (red lines)
   geom_vline(xintercept = 634400000, colour="red", lwd=0.3) +
   geom_vline(xintercept = 635000000, colour="red", lwd=0.3) +
   geom_vline(xintercept = 635600441, colour="green", lwd=0.3) +
   geom_vline(xintercept = 644277239 , colour="blue", lwd=0.3) +
  ggtitle(label = paste0("Dot plot of ",ref," chr2D against chr2D of ",query), subtitle =  paste0("Alignments longer than ", min_size, " bp")) +
  theme(plot.title=element_text(size=12, face = "bold.italic"))
dev.off()


#========================================================
#===== plot for region at interval where the xgwm320 had a hit on chr2D of Julius  ======
#===== alignments longer then 10kb, for a specific region ======

tiff(paste0(plot_dir,date,"_dot_plot",ref," _2D_VS_",query,"_","Xgwm320_hit_CS_Julius",min_size,"bp.tiff"), res = 300, width = 8.3, height = 4.8, units = "in")

 comparison_filt_all %>% filter(rs >= 644000000) %>%  filter(qs >= 655000000) %>% filter(r_length >= 10000) ->test_dat
  
  test_dat %>% plot_by_perc_id_cap(., cap_lower = 97, cap_upper = 100) + 
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 7 )) +
   theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7)) +
  scale_y_continuous(breaks = seq(min(test_dat$qs),max(test_dat$qs) ,250000), labels = scales::comma, name = paste0(query, " chr2D")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(min(test_dat$rs),max(test_dat$rs) ,250000), labels = scales::comma, name = paste0(ref, " chr2D")) +
     geom_hline(yintercept =656817041 , colour="red", lwd=0.3) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 644277239, colour="red", lwd=0.3) +
      ggtitle(label = paste0("Dot plot of ",ref," chr2D against chr2D of ",query, " alignments longer than ",min_size," bp")) +
    labs(subtitle = "Red line indicate location of hit for Xgwm320 SSR marker psuedo-sequence in each genome", caption = "On Julius:656,817,041 Mbp \n On Chinese spring:644,277,239 Mbp") +
  theme(plot.title=element_text(size=10))
  
  dev.off()
  
```

### Reading in the data with Julius as the reference and CS as the query

```{r}

base_dir <- "/Users/waweru/Documents/2022/Python_learning/python_learning_with_Burkhard/chr2D_CS_635-650Mb/mummer_out/"

# because we are looking at the whole chromosome, I start with a threshold of 0 for all alignmnents
# now using a threshold of 10kb alignmnents, based on lit that excluding shorter alignments 
#between non-syntenic retrotransposons which have a median size of 9584 bp in whea


cut_off <- 99.99

chr <- "2D"
chrom <- paste0("chr", chr)

# this the reference,
variety <- "julius"

# the query being compared to the reference
query <- "chinesespring"

data_dir_query <- paste0(base_dir,query,"/",variety,"_2D_VS_",query,"_2D.delta")

plot_dir <-  paste0(base_dir,query,"/")

ref <- variety

data_dir_query
plot_dir
```

Read all the data
```{r}
#============ read the data with all the alignments, original function =========
#==========================================================

min_size <- 0
comparison_filt_all <- pre_plot_analysis(delta_path = data_dir_query, min_size = min_size)

#=== read the data with filter function ===========================
#==========================================================
min_size <- 10000
ref_start <- 600000000
ref_end <- 661246758

comparison_filt_Jul <- pre_plot_analysis_ref_filt(delta_path = data_dir_query, min_size = min_size, ref_start = ref_start,ref_end = ref_end)
```
Looking at small specif regions. Here looking at the interval where the xgwm320 had a hit on chr2D of Julius.

tiff(paste0(plot_dir,date,"_dot_plot",ref," _2D_VS_",query,"_","Xgwm320_hit_CS_Julius",min_size,"bp.tiff"), res = 300, width = 8.3, height = 4.8, units = "in")

 comparison_filt_Jul %>% filter(rs >= 655000000)%>% filter(re <= 657750000) %>%  filter(qs >= 644000000) %>% filter(qe <= 645516000)-> test_dat_Jul

   theme(axis.text.y = element_text(size = 7)) +

      ggtitle(label = paste0("Dot plot of ",ref," chr2D against chr2D of ",query, " alignments longer than ",min_size," bp")) +
    labs(subtitle = "Red line indicate location of hit for Xgwm320 SSR marker psuedo-sequence in each genome", caption = "On Julius:656,817,041 Mbp \n On Chinese spring:644,277,239 Mbp") +
